unless the user is very explicit about it
Hey folks, I'm happy to pick this up if no one else is working on it. I'm fairly confident with what needs to change (thanks for linking to the original PR, @jreback).

issue.title: BUG: #12815 Always use np.nan for missing values of object dtypes

issue.body:
- [x] closes #12815
- [x] tests added / passed
- [x] passes `git diff upstream/master -u -- "*.py" | flake8 --diff`
- [x] whatsnew entry

Handles the issue of unstacked object columns filling missing values with `None` instead of `np.nan` by modifying `pd.core.dtypes.cast.maybe_promote()` to use a `fill_value` of `np.nan` (or `pd.NaT`) when the original `fill_value` is `None`.

Let me know if you'd like me to clarify anything!
